type.description: Type of link. Well-known values: `privacy_policy`, `terms_of_service`, `refund_policy`, `shipping_policy`, `faq`, `resume-checkout`. `resume-checkout` is a platform-hosted checkout URL the buyer must open in a browser to finish (e.g. after a SubmitFailed / 3DS / other verification-required result) — distinct from the policy-page links above. Consumers SHOULD handle unknown values gracefully by displaying them using the `title` field or omitting the link.

url.description: The actual URL pointing to the content to be displayed.

title.description: Optional display text for the link. When provided, use this instead of generating from type.
